messages.author: 139553f03a0e344d
messages.subject: Re: Smoothed lines coloured by factor
parts:
Hey Stephen,

If I'm following your intention, I think your solution doesn't require an additional layer or adjustment (e.g., adding scale_colour_manual to the mix). For the smoothing geom (smooth_geom), you can instead map the color aesthetic to hlv just like you mapped the group aesthetic to hlv. You mapped groups to hlv - this will shape how many geoms are produced (one for each group). Now you just need to map color the same way (assigning one color for each group).

Here's the code I used:
ggplot(preemlong, aes(x = event, y = SCORE, group = id)) + geom_smooth(aes(group = hlv, color = hlv), se = F, size = 2)

A PNG of the graph this produced is attached.

Your code is just about there... Just need to add one more argument to the geom_smooth aesthetic set.

Warm regards,
Brian

On Mon, Jun 3, 2013 at 9:27 PM, Stephen Peplow <stephen...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi...I have 35 subjects measured at three points. The subjects are divided into a control group and test group. I have arranged the data into long format. I want to plot two smoothed lines, one for each group. I want to assign a different colour to each line. I can successfully get the plot of each group by 

prhlv <- ggplot(preemlong, aes(event, SCORE, group = id)) +  geom_smooth(aes(group = hlv), se = F, size = 2)
prhlv  

where hlv is a binary for Yes and No. Event is the marker for when the test was taken and SCORE is what the subject received. 
This is all I want apart from colouring by group. 

I have tried scale_colour_manual but can't get it to work. I have put the dataset in my public dropbox folder

http://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/23281950/preemlong.csv

I have been working from Hadley's book specifically page 50 where he gives the Oxboys example

Your assistance highly welcome! 
Stephen

messages.subject: Re: Smoothed lines coloured by factor
parts:
I understand you want to draw lines grouped by id variable and then a smooth line grouped by hlv variable. If it's the case you should write something like:

ggplot(preemlong, aes(event, SCORE)) + geom_line(aes(group = id)) + geom_smooth(aes(group = hlv, colour = hlv), se = F, size = 2)

Does it help?

--
Hadri
